text_first_baseline.summary: The baseline condition prepares launch context from a broad text bundle. It identifies implementation planning as the next activity but leaves the allowed-files boundary and false-transition risk less explicit.

graph_field_guided.summary: The graph-field condition prepares launch context around guarded apply, launch record, allowed-files gate and false-transition risk. It blocks implementation movement until launch evidence and allowed artifact boundaries are present.
graph_field_guided.boundary_statement: Context preparation only; no implementation, production or release claim.
